Team —

I reviewed the Cloudspan_CO_Request.pdf. Quick legal take and proposed edits (I’m attaching a redlined MSA and a short comment doc):

- Cover the temporary pricing as a defined "Promotional Credit Period" (explicit start/end dates) to avoid permanent amendment to the fee schedule.
- Add a clause that the additional throughput top-up is scoped as "temporary capacity" with an automatic reversion to baseline on Jan 1, 2027 unless Cloudspan signs a 90-day notice to extend. This prevents open-ended commitment.
- Include an acceptance criterion for onboarding (ops playbook signoff + production traffic test window) before permanent billing of top-up.
- Require indemnity carveouts for any third-party data processors Cloudspan designates during pilot traffic (standard for private deployments).

I’ve attached: redwood_redline_msa_v2.docx (track changes) and a one-page legal summary. Laura — please confirm whether procurement is comfortable with the reversion approach; if not, we can propose a phased commitment (e.g., 60% billed during pilot ramp, remainder on sustained usage).

Will prioritize turnaround today; aim to get a DocuSign packet out to Cloudspan by EOD 10/21.

-Jordan

Quick procurement/finance notes — Laura here:

- I ran a high-level proforma using the consumption numbers in the request and attached a workbook: orderform_q4_pricing.xlsx. With the proposed temporary credits, Redwood's net is neutral if Cloudspan adheres to the Oct–Dec consumption estimates; risk grows if they double expected burst.
- To mitigate, I propose 2 guardrails: a) cap the refundable credit to the first $X of incremental usage; b) include an overage surcharge (tiered) if usage exceeds 150% of forecasted ramp.
- The reversion clause Jordan suggested is acceptable to finance. If Cloudspan wants permanent capacity, we can present a 12-month commitment price after Jan 1, 2027.

Action items:
1) Jordan: finalize redline for MSA + change order language (including Promotional Credit Period and overage tier language).
2) Rachel: propose a hard onboarding schedule (key ops milestones) and confirm infra SLA for Nov 15 target.
3) I'll prepare a short commercial sheet showing the credit cap and overage tiers to include in the DocuSign packet.

I'll be available for a quick sync 10/22 @ 09:00 PT if that helps.

—Laura

Thanks for the quick review and for the pragmatic guardrails. Cloudspan is comfortable with a Promotional Credit Period (Oct 1–Dec 31) and the reversion language so long as we have the Nov 15 onboarding milestone baked into the DocuSign packet.

If you can get the redlined MSA + change order and the commercial appendix into a single DocuSign link by EOD 10/22, we’ll route for signature and aim to provision the additional capacity by 10/29 pending ops validation.
